items.title: 提供一些关于Gucci涨价的新闻报道
items.summary: Sina Fashion reports Gucci's sixth price increase in two years took effect Oct 1, 2026, raising men's and women's handbags, small leather goods and select shoes 8-12%, with classic pieces like the Diana medium tote and Ophidia chain bags up roughly 1,500-3,500 RMB; piece frames it as a de-discounting push to defend luxury positioning even as newer Primavera-line items were cut in price weeks earlier, and notes resale prices for popular models ticked up 5-10% after the announcement.

items.title: Gucci涨价规律深度分析：近两年第6次，涨幅8-12%
items.summary: Weibo fashion-content account analyzes Gucci's Oct 1 price hike as the sixth adjustment in under two years, now coming every 4-5 months versus the historical 1-2 times annually; argues the brand is concentrating increases on recognizable classic lines while pulling back discounts, and runs through resale-value implications for shoppers deciding whether to buy before further hikes.

items.title: 国庆8天假第3天，"古驰官网降价最高超四成"和"8200元球鞋穿5次开裂"同屏刷屏
items.summary: SMZDM consumer community post published during National Day holiday weighs Gucci's up-to-40% official price cuts on select bags against a parallel complaint thread: a Hangzhou buyer says an 8,200 RMB Gucci sneaker cracked after fewer than five wears and under five km of walking, with Gucci initially denying warranty citing "external damage" before reversing the decision after social-media pressure; piece advises shoppers to weigh price tier, country of origin and return policy before Double 11.

items.title: 3.3萬元一雙！Gucci首推「中國製」運動鞋 遭外界質疑為省成本
items.summary: Taiwan outlet ETtoday reports on Gucci's first sneakers explicitly labeled "Made in China" -- the Drip (1,050 USD) and a leather slip-on (950 USD) from the Primavera line -- noting Gucci says the move reflects specific manufacturing technical requirements rather than cost-cutting, while observers question the justification given the brand's 12 straight quarters of sales declines and a 19% 2025 revenue drop; Gucci maintains about 95% of production stays in Italy.

items.title: 구찌, 새 스니커즈에 '메이드 인 중국' 붙여 판매 시작
items.summary: Korean community (Etoland humor board) thread mocks Gucci for openly labeling new sneakers "Made in China," with the poster framing it as luxury brands brazenly dropping pretense; comment section splits between one user arguing factory location doesn't determine quality since Gucci controls standards, and another countering that China's manufacturing reputation hurts consumer perception regardless.

items.source: Weibo (消费者对Gucci中国制造鞋接受度)
items.title: 消费者对Gucci中国制造鞋接受度怎么样？
items.summary: Weibo discussion thread on consumer acceptance of Gucci's China-made shoes finds reactions split: some say the China label "lowers the sense of luxury," others say origin doesn't matter if design and quality hold up; notes a product-development-adjacent blogger claiming the shoe is comfortable with first-batch sellout and only 3% return rate, while Kering's CEO is cited saying Chinese consumers increasingly weigh quality and experience over logo status.

items.title: 新浪时尚热点小时报丨2026年10月03日12时
items.summary: Sina's hourly fashion-trending digest for Oct 3 logs Gucci appearing in organic social commerce comparison chatter alongside Hermes, Chanel, Patek Philippe and LV topics, indicating Gucci remains a reference point in Chinese consumer price/value comparison discussions during the National Day holiday shopping window.

items.title: 피렌체 장인정신 버렸나... 구찌가 '중국산 스니커즈' 출시한 속사정
items.summary: Insight reports on Gucci's Demna-designed Drip sneaker (about 800 euros/$1,000) made in China, noting Gucci's defense that Italy remains core to its identity while the China move reflects manufacturer technical capability, against the backdrop of Kering revenue roughly halving over three years and ongoing store closures.
